note: Stanislaus NF campground in mixed conifer on Hwy 108 east of Dardanelle, above the Middle Fork Stanislaus River (no designated trail down to it). Free RV water fill at the old Brightman Flat fire station on Hwy 108; the nearest dump station is on Hwy 108 near Pinecrest Lake Road ($10). Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov read: first-come only (rec.gov 245554 info-only), $25 (+extra-vehicle fee), 33 dirt sites, 14-night max, 6 people, May-Oct, vault toilets, no water; senior pass 50% posted. WATERFRONT riverview -> recommend not waterfront (river ~45-60 m off, ~8 m down, under unbroken canopy, no trail). Website and concessionaire phone.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'riverview' (not --AWH) -> recommend 'not waterfront'. The Middle Fork Stanislaus runs under unbroken green conifer canopy ~45-60 m north of the northernmost clearings (Esri + topo), and 3DEP from 38.3531,-119.8490 puts the channel ~8 m below the clearing at 40-50 m; the FS page says 'There is no designated trail down to the river'. No site map or site points exist (rec.gov info-only), so no site can be tied to a view; under canopy satellite can only veto, and the stream is creek-sized. Default down. Proposed evidence: 'FS page + Esri/topo + 3DEP 2026-11-27: dirt spurs in clearings between Hwy 108 and the Middle Fork Stanislaus; river ~45-60 m from the nearest clearing, ~8 m down under unbroken canopy, no trail to it (FS); no site can be shown to see the water.'
